_comment: What the question reader must produce for questions whose difficulty is the reading, not the counting (CASES.md, G1-G6). 'outcome' is plan, clarify or limitation (lib/nibrs-plan/plan.ts ReaderOutcome). These are checked against the reader's output by a person or a test; the numbers come from the counting cases.

cases.question: murders in the US in 2024
must: geography is national: a sum of reported counts across agencies, never an agency named 'US' or 'USA'

cases.question: murders in Springfield in 2024
must: options name each Springfield police department with its state
no number is given before the place is chosen

cases.question: thefts from cars where a firearm was stolen in Memphis in 2024
must: the firearm is property (loss 7, description 13) in an incident-scoped existence filter, as N2

cases.question: car thefts in Baltimore from January 2022 to June 2026
must: period 2022-01 through 2026-06, monthly or as asked; no clarification

cases.question: how many murders in Houston were committed by undocumented immigrants
must: no murder count that drops the condition

cases.question: why did carjackings fall in Memphis
must: reason explanation_requested: no causes, policy or trend commentary
no added offer or commentary (owner 2026-10-27: minimize editorializing)
